rows.section: Income tax on wages (gelir vergisi), 2026
rows.label: Step 1
rows.basis: Annual taxable wage income (cumulative through the year)
rows.note: Each rate applies to the part of income inside the step. Tax at the step thresholds: TRY 28,500, TRY 70,500, TRY 367,500, TRY 1,697,500. rows.section: Minimum-wage exemption from income tax and stamp tax
rows.label: Income tax
rows.value: Wages up to the gross minimum wage less the employee's SGK and unemployment contributions are exempt (GVK art. 23(1)(18)); the exempt part still counts when finding the step for the rest
rows.note: A worker paid exactly the minimum wage pays no income tax or stamp tax, only the employee's social-security and unemployment contributions.
rows.source_title: GİB: Ücret Geliri Rehberi (February 2026), 4.3; Gelir Vergisi Kanunu art. 23(1)(18); Damga Vergisi Kanunu table 2, IV-34
